note: CORPUS-M5-PRERUN (R1 close-out F1): drift sentinels. Every scoring batch for a site carries these rows as ordinary rows after its batch rows, WITHOUT reference scores (unlike the rubric's anchors). Ingest compares each one's fit with its pilot fit; more than 0.15 off fails the batch, which is re-asked. A sentinel is never written as a score row unless the batch asked it as one of its own rows. Kept out of rubrics/<site>.yaml so the rubric blob sha (and every score's version) is unchanged. pilot = the median of the 3 FIX3 pilot runs (fix3/pilot/moh-run{1,2,3}.scores.json, rubric-moh@1.3.0+388b42b0f728). Chosen for spread 0-0.05 across the 3 FIX3 runs, one per band, none a control or an anchor, and none reproducing an anchor's per-criterion vector in any FIX3 run (a row that copies an anchor would echo it and could not drift).
